item.headline: Looking for the Formula to Stop an Apocalypse
item.summary: Mike Winer and his colleagues are trying to build a mathematical safeguard to keep A.I. under human control. They fear they are running out of time.
item.author: Eli Saslow and Erin Schaff

reads.result: A group of researchers is racing to build a mathematical safeguard to keep A.I. under human control, and they fear time is running out.
